title: Experiment Variable Role Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Assign each of ten items in a model-comparison experiment its role: independent, controlled, measured, or uncontrolled.

learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate the role of each of 10 items in a model-comparison experiment as independent variable, controlled variable, measured result, or uncontrolled variable, with at least 9 of 10 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Items 9 and 10 both mention a model's default setting, and have different roles. State the difference.
commonMisconceptions: Anything that is the same in every run is controlled, whether or not it was decided.
A measured result can also be the independent variable.
A variable that cannot be controlled can be ignored.
The model's default setting counts as controlled.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 9 of 10 correct on the first attempt.
